Based on the Hermes Agent onboarding document:

- **Verify Canonical Model Names in `agent.log`:** Standard supported DeepSeek models are `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner`. To prevent unintended model routing and unexpected costs/deductions, verify the canonical model mappings being dispatched in your `agent.log`.

*(Note: The documentation does not contain specific details regarding "DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro" model aliases or background auto-drain bugs. If non-standard model identifiers were specified, Hermes may have routed requests differently; checking `agent.log` will confirm the exact canonical model and requests being made.)*
